apps.localizedDescription: RyukGram is an enhanced Instagram client for iOS by @axryuk — the full Instagram app with a built-in suite of privacy, logging and customisation tools that all run on-device. It adds follow-request tracking, read-receipt and seen-state control, device-ID masking, a deleted-message log, story-viewer insights and a stories archive, media downloading for posts, reels, stories and DMs, custom chat themes and fonts, per-account setting profiles, an Instagram mobile-config browser and a configurable tab bar. The release notes for each build are carried through from the developer's own source.

compatibility.notes: Resolved from the developer's own AltStore source at source.ryuksign.com (the /plugins variant, which keeps the plugin loader enabled). The IPA shares com.burbn.instagram with iNKillerPlus — installing one replaces the other, so keep a single Instagram mod installed. Modified third-party client: sideloading means trusting the developer, and the base app's own terms still apply.
